meta.title: View-Only Mode blocks counter offers, quote edits and surrogate bids
gaps: The catalog cannot directly perform or assert a buyer-side quote edit being blocked by View-Only Mode.
The catalog has no dedicated assertion that View-Only Mode was successfully enabled beyond clicking its menu item.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog cannot directly perform or assert a buyer-side quote edit being blocked by View-Only Mode.; The catalog has no dedicated assertion that View-Only Mode was successfully enabled beyond clicking its menu item.

steps.note: Open the prepared live auction Responses tab specified by the test setup.
Enable the mode whose restrictions are under test.
Reach the bid comparison context required before checking counter-offer behavior.
Verify that sending a counter offer is refused while View-Only Mode is enabled.
Open the auction Participants list where surrogate bidding is offered.
Verify that placing a surrogate bid is refused while View-Only Mode is enabled.
Use the available supplier session to approximate the unavailable quote-edit action.
Open the auction bid sheet for the invited vendor.
Attempt a vendor quote revision; this is only a closest approximation because buyer-side quote editing is not represented by a catalog step.
